# Code Anchors: Distill Command

- `libs/portable-tools/src/distill-command.ts` — the command: the ordered pre-start checks, the run folder and live-run marker, the permission-mode line, the session start in the close worktree, the platform check that decides the outcome, and the detached background runner with its status lines.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/distill-command.spec.ts` — pins every refusal, the platform-read outcome rule, the marker, the fixed prompt, both harnesses and the background run.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — registers the distill verb and its options on the shared executable.
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/close-command.ts` — close's pull-request-to-epic resolution, exported so this command resolves an epic exactly as close does.
- `README.md` — the adopter-facing usage of the command, its permission default and its cleanup command.
